args.question: Someone in your household has a milk-related dietary restriction. Which one applies — lactose-free, dairy-free (e.g., plant-based milk), or something else (please specify)?

trajectory.message: We need milk that is labeled both dairy-free and nut-free. Soy or oat milk is fine. Just one 1 L carton.
